note: The root key records the consonants of the place name. Its derivation is unknown.
summary: Genesis 14:1 names Ellasar as the place ruled by Arioch. It lists Ellasar alongside Shinar and Elam in the titles of the kings.

senses.definition: The place of which Arioch is called king.

evidence.note: The title מֶלֶךְ אֶלָּסָר identifies Arioch by the place he rules.
